title: Felix and the Blue Hour
author: Juniper Thackeray
blurb: Coral Crane, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, has spent ten years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it before the last bus to the old neighborhood is rerouted forever.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
